stem.text: The diagrams show the quark composition of four different hadrons. One of the hadrons is a $\Sigma^{+}$ particle. It has a charge of $+e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
Which hadron could be the $\Sigma^{+}$ particle?

A.alt: Grey circle containing three labelled circles: d, s and d.

B.alt: Grey circle containing three labelled circles: d, s and s.

C.alt: Grey circle containing three labelled circles: u, s and s.

D.alt: Grey circle containing three labelled circles: u, s and u.
